items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Coleman Hawkins extensively. The name 'Fletcher' appears only in the interviewer's question ('So significant, back with Fletcher...') as a reference to a past association (likely Duke Ellington) to contextualize Hawkins' career longevity. The interviewee does not mention Fl

ctx.x: So significant, back with Fletcher...But to see you--of course you played with everybody who's anybody, so--but to see that Coleman Hawkins, one of those who has this longevity but still continues to be exploring and working with others...Coleman Hawkins and Duke, Coleman Hawkins with John Coltrane, Coleman Hawkins with Kenny Burrell, I mean continuing to expand his horizons.
Yeah, I've been so fortunate it's unbelievable man.
